subject: Tech screen scheduling and platform access — Riley Carter
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karen Mills <karen@university.edu>, Riley Carter <riley.carter@gmail.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Tech screen scheduling and platform access — Riley Carter

Hi all,

We have a candidate, Riley Carter, for the ML Platform Engineer role. Quick summary: strong systems background, submitted resume attached, prefers early-afternoon PST for interview slots. I scheduled tentative 30m on Riley's Calendly (link below) but want to confirm interviewer routing and tooling before sending the formal invite.

Proposed flow (30m):
- 5m intro / role framing (tessa)
- 20m live coding (Dev) on CoderPad (link below)
- 5m quick culture / next steps (Laura)

Requests:
- Dev: can you own the coding prompt and the CoderPad instance? I attached techscreen_problem_v2.pdf (simple systems + debugging).
- Laura: can you cover closing / cultural fit and have debrief notes ready in the hiring doc?
- Hannah: please take notes/score (use the rubric in the shared drive) and add debrief link to the calendar invite.

Platform details: CoderPad session: https://coderpad.io/r/RC-7782 (I created a temp pad and preloaded the problem). Please do not edit the problem file itself; let candidate code in the pad.
Calendar placeholder: I’ll send the invite after confirmations — will include the CoderPad link + GDrive resume.

Attachments: riley_carter_resume.pdf, techscreen_problem_v2.pdf

If you can confirm availability by 10:30am PST I’ll finalize.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Recruiting Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Tech screen scheduling and platform access — Riley Carter

Tessa — thanks. I can take the coding portion. 12:30–1:00pm PST works for me (I blocked it on my calendar tentatively). A few notes:

- I’ll use the CoderPad link you created. Please ensure the pad is set to allow language switching (candidate may prefer Python).
- I’ll open the problem as "Problem B" so we have a fallback if the live pad has latency.
- I prefer to have my mic/video on; if Riley is remote, we should confirm video is OK in the invite.

I’ll prep one hint in a hidden comment so we can gauge candidate independence.

—Dev

Thanks everyone — finalizing details below and sending the calendar invite.

Final schedule (PST):
- 12:45–12:50pm — Intro / role framing (Tessa)
- 12:50–1:10pm — Live coding / systems problem (Dev) — CoderPad: https://coderpad.io/r/RC-7782
- 1:10–1:15pm — Close / next steps (Laura)
- 1:15–1:25pm — Debrief (internal only) — Hannah to chair notes (meeting will have 10-min buffer on calendar)

Calendar invite sent to Riley and interviewers (attachment: calendar-invite.ics). I included the GDrive link to Riley's resume and the evaluation rubric. Please use the debrief template in the drive: https://drive.google.com/document/d/DEBRIEF_TEMPLATE

Thanks — Tessa
